original_protocol_scope: D1/D2 fixed support census,32jointrollouts.2syntheticinstances×2informationlayouts×4repeats×2backends. All3roles are model decisions; no forced proactive/requested prompts. Separate backend queues may execute at different times from same frozeninventory. Not algorithm effect or independent-source generalization.

conclusions.explanation: Three valid semantic joint traces occur in three different situations. Each respective situation has one observed method example, below the frozen class threshold 2; they cannot be pooled into same-situation multi-class support. Independently, all API completions lack actual token_trace, so no current member actor trajectory is trainable. b is empty, v=0, and Q=B weights remain 1 over all original slots, with actor masks zero.

unknown_interpretation: The two V=unknown episodes finished with content pass/reward1 but had real disconnected transport attempts followed by retries; the frozen record gate conservatively cannot certify the complete behavior draw. Two additional V=false episodes also have record=unknown, with independently false basis/delivery taking precedence. Unknown has not been replaced with failure0.
review_basis_scope: basis=true certifies checks for duties that actually occurred. It does not claim an unexecuted reviewer inspection occurred: an otherwise correct unapproved submission is excluded by delivery=false. Evidence presentation is observable, not proof of internal reasoning or causal necessity.
cloud_identity_limit: All three actors were actual DeepSeek API decisions with target_model origin. Reported alias/model_revision is preserved; immutable cloud weights are not independently verified. No rule witness or teacher supplied this target support.
